column1: # Compiled 2026-10-11 by Manigent Contributors from state statutes and the Federal Register (public law; facts restated, not copied). Not exhaustive: many other states have consumer auto-renewal laws; only the ones listed were read.

column3: contracts for service, maintenance or repair of real or personal property
column5: Auto-renewal unenforceable against the recipient unless the provider serves written notice personally or by certified mail 15-30 days before the recipient's non-renewal deadline, calling attention to the clause. Email alone is not a listed method.
column6: 15-30 days before the opt-out deadline; renewal periods of 1 month or less excepted
column7: renewal clause unenforceable against the customer

column5: Auto-renewal of the lease unenforceable unless the lessor serves written notice personally or by mail 15-30 days before the lessee's deadline.
column6: 15-30 days; renewal periods of 1 month or less excepted
column7: renewal clause unenforceable against the lessee

column3: business contracts: business-equipment leases and business services for an end user doing business in WI (15 exclusions, e.g. usage contracts with a $250,000+ minimum in 12 months, real property, vehicle and medical-equipment leases)
column5: Contracts entered/renewed after 2011-05-01 that auto-renew for more than 1 month need a signed or initialled conspicuous disclosure (renewal, length, any price increase, how and by when to decline). If initial and renewal terms exceed 1 year, written notice 15-60 days before the decline deadline.
column6: 15-60 days; damages 2x actual or lesser of 2x periodic payment or $1,000, plus fees
column7: auto-renewal unenforceable; contract ends at the end of the current term

column2: Bus. & Prof. Code 17600-17606 (ARL, as amended by AB 2863)
column5: For contracts entered, amended or extended on or after 2025-07-01: express affirmative consent to the renewal terms; keep proof of consent 3 years or 1 year after termination if longer; pre-renewal notice 15-45 days before renewal for terms of 1 year or more; price-change notice 7-30 days before the change takes effect, with how to cancel; annual reminder for annual plans; online cancellation for online sign-ups.
column7: goods/services sent without consent are an unconditional gift; UCL exposure

column5: Clear disclosure before acceptance; confirmation; notice of a material change before it takes effect with cancel instructions (change made without it is void); free trial over 30 days: reminder 5-30 days before it ends; annual reminder by mail or email for continuous service; online cancellation (325G.60).

column2: FTC Negative Option Rule, 16 CFR part 425
column5: 2024 'click-to-cancel' amendments vacated by the 8th Circuit (July 2025); FTC restored part 425 to its pre-2024 text effective 2026-02-12 (91 FR 6507); new rulemaking started with an ANPRM on 2026-03-11. ROSCA and Section 5 still apply to online negative-option sales.
